sap.description: Sensors and alarm under constant watch.

whatWeDo.subheading: We combine engineering experience with practical execution: we analyse needs, design, commission and maintain building technical systems.

cards.title: Energy efficiency
cards.description: Automation and BMS helping achieve user comfort and optimise maintenance costs through lower energy consumption.

cards.title: Service & maintenance
cards.description: Periodic inspections, service reports, repairs, improvements and technical support on-site and remotely.

cards.title: Security systems
cards.description: CCTV, IDS, ACS, T&A, FAS, PA and integration of security systems in monitoring and protection centres.

proces.heading: Project delivery process
proces.subheading: We manage every project from the first meeting through to long-term maintenance. Each phase is documented and agreed with the client.

steps.title: Analysis & audit
steps.description: We assess existing installations, technical and operational requirements. We prepare a report with recommendations and scope of work.

steps.title: Design & engineering
steps.description: We develop technical documentation, select equipment and systems. The design is agreed with the investor and accounts for future expansion.

steps.title: Installation & commissioning
steps.description: We carry out installation according to the design, conduct FAT/SAT testing, commission systems and train facility staff.

steps.title: Service & support
steps.description: We provide periodic inspections, remote monitoring, fault response and technical support throughout the entire installation lifecycle.

systemy.heading: Six disciplines, one integration
systemy.subheading: We design and integrate building engineering systems as a single coherent solution — reliable, easy to manage and ready for the future.

items.title: BMS
items.subtitle: Building Management System
items.description: Central supervision and management of all building installations from a single operator interface.

items.title: BAS
items.subtitle: Building Automation System
items.description: Automation of lighting, HVAC and other systems based on schedules, occupancy sensors and setpoints.

items.title: CCTV
items.subtitle: IP Video Surveillance
items.description: IP industrial CCTV systems: cameras, NVR recorders, video management and access control integration.

items.title: FAS
items.subtitle: Fire Alarm System
items.description: Design and installation of fire alarm systems compliant with EN 54 standards, with addressable control panels.

items.title: ACS / T&A
items.subtitle: Access Control
items.description: Access control and time & attendance systems: card readers, electromagnetic locks, HR system integration.

items.title: HVAC
items.subtitle: HVAC Automation
items.description: Automation of air handling units, chillers, heat pumps and refrigeration systems.

helpdesk.heading: HelpDesk & service

features.title: Fast response time
features.description: Guaranteed remote response time: up to 2 hours. On-site service intervention: in accordance with SLA.

features.title: Remote and on-site
features.description: BMS/BAS diagnostics and remote control. If needed — our technician will come to your facility.
